subheadline.id: Membangun AI dan software kelas production untuk perbankan, fintech, dan enterprise.

bio.en: I am an AI and Software Engineer based in Jakarta, with 4+ years of experience building production systems for digital banking, fintech and enterprise SaaS. Since February 2026, I have led the delivery of Azure-native AI platforms at Metrodata for 12+ enterprise clients in sectors such as banking, automotive, mining and food manufacturing. The work includes multi-agent RAG assistants, realtime voice agents, document AI and AI code security. Before that, I built backends and full-stack products for e-commerce, travel, SaaS and digital banking, including roles at MNC, Jatis and Jenius. I make LLM systems reliable in production through evaluation, guardrails and observability.
bio.id: Saya AI dan Software Engineer di Jakarta, dengan pengalaman 4+ tahun membangun sistem production untuk perbankan digital, fintech, dan SaaS enterprise. Sejak Februari 2026, saya memimpin delivery platform AI berbasis Azure di Metrodata untuk 12+ klien enterprise di berbagai sektor, antara lain perbankan, otomotif, pertambangan, dan manufaktur makanan. Proyeknya mencakup asisten RAG multi-agent, voice agent realtime, document AI, dan keamanan kode berbasis AI. Sebelumnya, saya membangun backend dan produk full-stack untuk e-commerce, travel, SaaS, dan perbankan digital, termasuk di MNC, Jatis, dan Jenius. Saya membuat sistem LLM andal di production lewat evaluasi, guardrail, dan observability.

story.en: I started learning Android development at a vocational school in Malang and opened my GitHub account in 2016. Through school and Telkom University, I earned 20 competition placings, including seven first places, in work ranging from chatbot prototypes to data science and capture-the-flag. I helped lead a 200-student programming club, trained an IndoBERT model for campus sentiment analysis and supported myself with part-time e-commerce backend work. At MNC, Jatis and Jenius, I built travel payments, multi-tenant SaaS and digital-banking integrations. In 2026, I joined Metrodata's Microsoft AI practice. I now write the specs, direct AI coding agents in parallel and review their work before merging. I build voice agents that callers can interrupt mid-sentence, a security platform that opens fix PRs and document AI that must not guess. Evaluation determines which changes I release.
story.id: Saya mulai belajar pengembangan Android di SMK di Malang dan membuka akun GitHub pada 2016. Selama sekolah dan kuliah di Telkom University, saya meraih 20 prestasi kompetisi, termasuk tujuh juara 1, lewat proyek dari prototipe chatbot hingga data science dan capture-the-flag. Saya ikut memimpin klub programming beranggotakan 200 mahasiswa, melatih model IndoBERT untuk analisis sentimen kampus, dan membiayai kebutuhan saya lewat pekerjaan backend e-commerce paruh waktu. Di MNC, Jatis, dan Jenius, saya membangun sistem pembayaran travel, SaaS multi-tenant, dan integrasi perbankan digital. Pada 2026, saya bergabung dengan praktik Microsoft AI di Metrodata. Kini saya menulis spec, mengarahkan AI coding agent secara paralel, dan meninjau hasilnya sebelum merge. Saya membangun voice agent yang bisa disela di tengah kalimat, platform keamanan yang membuka fix PR, dan document AI yang tidak boleh menebak. Hasil evaluasi menentukan perubahan yang saya rilis.

howIWork.en: I define each feature in a written spec with acceptance criteria. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Codex implement much of the code in parallel; I remain responsible for design, review, verification in a deployed environment and the merge. I use gold sets, A/B tests, CI gates and shadow mode to evaluate changes, and report metrics with their measurement method.
howIWork.id: Saya menetapkan setiap fitur dalam spec tertulis dengan acceptance criteria. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, dan Codex mengerjakan sebagian besar implementasi secara paralel; saya tetap bertanggung jawab atas desain, review, verifikasi di environment yang sudah di-deploy, dan merge. Saya mengevaluasi perubahan dengan gold set, A/B test, CI gate, dan shadow mode, serta menyertakan metode pengukuran saat melaporkan metrik.

text.en: I write a numbered spec with acceptance criteria and a constitution that sets the agents' working rules before implementation starts.
text.id: Sebelum implementasi, saya menulis spec bernomor dengan acceptance criteria dan constitution yang menetapkan aturan kerja agent.

text.en: AI coding agents implement much of the code in parallel. I am responsible for design, review, verification in a deployed environment and the merge decision.
text.id: AI coding agent mengerjakan sebagian besar kode secara paralel. Saya bertanggung jawab atas desain, review, verifikasi di environment yang sudah di-deploy, dan keputusan merge.

text.en: I evaluate changes with gold sets, A/B tests, CI gates and shadow mode. I record negative results and leave changes disabled when they do not help.
text.id: Saya mengevaluasi perubahan dengan gold set, A/B test, CI gate, dan shadow mode. Hasil negatif saya catat, dan perubahan yang tidak membantu tetap saya nonaktifkan.

text.en: I plan for failures and build a recovery path rather than assume the system will always work.
text.id: Saya memperhitungkan kegagalan dan menyiapkan jalur pemulihan, bukan menganggap sistem akan selalu berjalan tanpa masalah.

text.en: I publish a metric only when I can explain how it was measured: in the lab, offline or live.
text.id: Saya hanya menampilkan metrik jika bisa menjelaskan cara pengukurannya: di lab, secara offline, atau live.

title.en: How I run AI in production
title.id: Cara saya menjalankan AI di production

intro.en: I treat observability as part of the feature, not an afterthought. Every AI service I ship on Azure is instrumented with OpenTelemetry through the Azure Monitor distro, on Python (FastAPI, Functions) and Node (Next.js), across App Service, Functions and Container Apps.
intro.id: Bagi saya, observability adalah bagian dari fitur, bukan tambahan di akhir. Setiap layanan AI yang saya rilis di Azure memakai instrumentasi OpenTelemetry lewat distro Azure Monitor. Ini mencakup Python (FastAPI, Functions) dan Node (Next.js) pada App Service, Functions, dan Container Apps.

text.en: Each model call records token usage (including reasoning and cached tokens), model, provider and agent, so cost and latency can be traced per feature.
text.id: Setiap panggilan model mencatat pemakaian token (termasuk reasoning dan cached token), model, provider, dan agent, sehingga biaya dan latensi bisa ditelusuri per fitur.

text.en: Alert rules, action groups and diagnostic settings live in Bicep next to the app and ship with azd: 44 rules in production today, covering daily and month-to-date spend, reasoning-token spikes, 429 throttling per deployment, judge latency and failed evaluation gates.
text.id: Alert rule, action group, dan diagnostic setting ditulis di Bicep bersama aplikasinya dan dirilis dengan azd: 44 rule aktif di production saat ini, mencakup biaya harian dan bulan berjalan, lonjakan reasoning token, throttling 429 per deployment, latensi judge, dan evaluation gate yang gagal.

text.en: Personal data is redacted before export, noisy spans are sampled, and ingestion has a daily cap with an alert at 80 percent.
text.id: Data pribadi disamarkan sebelum diekspor, span yang menambah noise di-sampling, dan ingestion punya batas harian dengan alert di 80 persen.

text.en: For a ticketing marketplace backend I provisioned Prometheus and Grafana as code, with black-box probes on the public API every 5 seconds plus Postgres, Redis and host metrics.
text.id: Untuk backend marketplace tiket, saya menyiapkan Prometheus dan Grafana sebagai kode, dengan black-box probe ke API publik setiap 5 detik serta metrik Postgres, Redis, dan host.

outro.en: This site is also monitored: an anonymous performance beacon, nightly performance runs, and public visit stats at the Visitor Observatory in the Lobby.
outro.id: Situs ini juga dipantau: beacon performa anonim, uji performa setiap malam, dan statistik kunjungan publik di Observatorium Pengunjung di Lobby.

tagline.en: eVendor, Metrodata's vendor portal for purchase orders, delivery acceptance, invoices, tax checks and approvals, built by one engineer in six weeks.
tagline.id: eVendor, portal vendor Metrodata untuk purchase order, penerimaan barang, invoice, verifikasi pajak, dan approval, dikerjakan oleh satu engineer dalam enam minggu.

role.en: Sole engineer and operator, responsible for design, AI coding agent direction, review and delivery
role.id: Engineer dan operator tunggal, bertanggung jawab atas desain, arahan AI coding agent, review, dan delivery

problem.en: Metrodata needed one vendor portal built around the purchase order: vendor onboarding, delivery acceptance (BAST), invoices with several tax types, and accounting and tax approvals that run in parallel. SAP failures must not stop the portal. The business owner gave weekly direction, including a process revision that users approved mid-project and that moved the whole workflow onto the purchase order. The gallery shows a masked local demo, not production captures.
problem.id: Metrodata membutuhkan satu portal vendor yang berpusat pada purchase order: onboarding vendor, penerimaan barang (BAST), invoice dengan beberapa jenis pajak, serta approval akuntansi dan pajak yang berjalan paralel. Gangguan SAP tidak boleh menghentikan portal. Business owner memberikan arahan mingguan, termasuk revisi proses yang disetujui pengguna di tengah proyek dan memindahkan seluruh alur kerja ke purchase order. Galeri menampilkan demo lokal yang sudah disamarkan, bukan tangkapan layar produksi.

approach.en: I wrote 51 numbered specs, directed AI coding agents through the implementation and reviewed every pull request behind CI gates before it merged.
approach.id: Saya menulis 51 spec bernomor dan mengarahkan AI coding agent selama implementasi. Setiap pull request saya tinjau dan wajib melewati CI gate sebelum di-merge.

approach.en: I modelled 21 backend domains in FastAPI and PostgreSQL with 109 Alembic migrations, then rebuilt the workflow around one purchase order workspace shared by vendors and staff after the user-approved process change.
approach.id: Saya memodelkan 21 domain backend di FastAPI dan PostgreSQL dengan 109 migrasi Alembic. Setelah pengguna menyetujui perubahan proses, saya membangun ulang alur kerja dalam satu workspace purchase order yang dipakai bersama oleh vendor dan staf.

approach.en: I isolated SAP behind a provider port with retries, rate limits and a circuit breaker so ERP delays cannot cascade into the portal. The port and the tax invoice check currently serve seeded data.
approach.id: Saya mengisolasi SAP di balik provider port dengan retry, rate limit, dan circuit breaker agar keterlambatan ERP tidak merembet ke portal. Saat ini, port tersebut dan pengecekan faktur pajak masih menyajikan data seed.

approach.en: I implemented Entra ID single sign-on and local Argon2id accounts, re-checking roles on every request. Deployment uses Bicep, VNet integration and Key Vault references.
approach.id: Saya menerapkan single sign-on Entra ID dan akun lokal Argon2id, dengan pengecekan ulang peran di setiap request. Deployment menggunakan Bicep, integrasi VNet, dan Key Vault reference.

approach.en: I diagnosed production failures: a build step that stopped the app from starting, a sign-in teardown race, and a session cookie that grew past the browser's 4 KB limit and silently broke staff sign-in.
approach.id: Saya menelusuri kegagalan produksi: langkah build yang membuat aplikasi gagal start, race condition saat teardown login, dan cookie sesi yang melewati batas 4 KB browser sehingga login staf gagal tanpa pesan.

role.en: Full Stack Engineer in a two-person team (backend foundation, accounts, events, caching and uploads, the attendee site and the organizer dashboard)
role.id: Full Stack Engineer dalam tim dua orang (fondasi backend, akun, acara, caching dan upload, situs pengunjung, serta dashboard penyelenggara)

problem.en: Serupa needed its own ticketing platform: organizers publish events with ticket tiers, attendees find events and get free or paid tickets online, and every order ends in a ticket that can be shown at the door. Two freelance engineers built it as three apps between June and August 2025.
problem.id: Serupa membutuhkan platform ticketing sendiri: penyelenggara memublikasikan acara dengan beberapa tier tiket, pengunjung mencari acara dan mendapatkan tiket gratis maupun berbayar secara online, dan setiap pesanan berakhir dengan tiket yang bisa ditunjukkan di pintu masuk. Dua engineer freelance membangunnya sebagai tiga aplikasi antara Juni dan Agustus 2025.

approach.en: I set up the API on Express 5 and Bun with routes, controllers, services and repositories over PostgreSQL and Drizzle, plus Helmet, rate limiting, structured logs, seed data and GitHub Actions deploys.
approach.id: Saya menyiapkan API di Express 5 dan Bun dengan lapisan route, controller, service, dan repository di atas PostgreSQL dan Drizzle, ditambah Helmet, rate limiting, log terstruktur, data seed, dan deploy lewat GitHub Actions.

approach.en: I built accounts and events in the API: JWT access and refresh tokens, email verification and password reset, user and admin roles, event search with filters, a Redis event cache with invalidation, rate-limited view counts and S3 uploads for event covers and profile photos.
approach.id: Saya membangun fitur akun dan acara di API: access token dan refresh token JWT, verifikasi email dan reset password, peran user dan admin, pencarian acara dengan filter, cache acara di Redis dengan invalidasi, penghitungan view dengan rate limit, serta upload cover acara dan foto profil ke S3.

approach.en: I built the attendee site in Next.js with TanStack Query, from event discovery and search to event pages with ticket tiers. It includes a free-ticket flow, checkout with a payment method choice, payment result pages and My Tickets with QR codes, plus SEO metadata and a sitemap.
approach.id: Saya membangun situs pengunjung dengan Next.js dan TanStack Query, dari penelusuran dan pencarian acara hingga halaman acara dengan tier tiket. Fiturnya mencakup alur tiket gratis, checkout dengan pilihan metode pembayaran, halaman hasil pembayaran, dan My Tickets dengan kode QR, beserta metadata SEO dan sitemap.

approach.en: I turned a v0-generated scaffold into the organizer dashboard and connected sign-in and event creation, editing and listing, with sub-categories and a location map, to the API.
approach.id: Saya mengubah kerangka hasil v0 menjadi dashboard penyelenggara dan menghubungkan login serta pembuatan, pengeditan, dan daftar acara, lengkap dengan sub-kategori dan peta lokasi, ke API.

approach.en: My teammate built ticket orders and payments in the API: quota and per-user limits, payment links and callbacks for QRIS, cards, e-wallets and virtual accounts, PDF invoices, status emails and Socket.IO payment events. My checkout and My Tickets pages call those endpoints.
approach.id: Rekan tim saya membangun pemesanan tiket dan pembayaran di API: batas kuota dan batas per pengguna, link pembayaran dan callback untuk QRIS, kartu, e-wallet, dan virtual account, invoice PDF, email status, serta event pembayaran lewat Socket.IO. Halaman checkout dan My Tickets buatan saya memanggil endpoint tersebut.

problem.en: A GitHub organization with 100+ repositories needed consistent pull-request security scanning, clear triage and fixes that engineers could review safely before merging.
problem.id: Organisasi GitHub dengan 100+ repository membutuhkan security scanning yang konsisten pada pull request, triage yang jelas, dan perbaikan yang dapat di-review engineer sebelum merge.

tagline.en: A national bakery brand's demand-planning platform on Microsoft Fabric: an on-premise database migrated into a medallion lakehouse, a forecasting dashboard and a data agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

problem.en: Planners needed a demand-forecasting dashboard, but the client's sales and master data lived in an on-premise database. After a fast production launch on Microsoft Fabric, loads stalled for about 21 seconds. The next requirement was a pipeline from the client's own source data.
problem.id: Tim perencana membutuhkan dashboard forecasting permintaan, tetapi data penjualan dan master data klien berada di database on-premise. Platform ini cepat diluncurkan di production pada Microsoft Fabric, tetapi pemuatan tersendat sekitar 21 detik. Kebutuhan berikutnya adalah pipeline dari data sumber milik klien.

approach.en: I deployed a static Next.js app on Fabric, reading lakehouse views through a GraphQL data API and validating results with a 168-check reconciliation harness.

approach.en: I used zero-row and capacity probes to confirm capacity throttling, correcting my earlier diagnosis. I replaced an 83,824-row read with about 3,000 streamed aggregates.
approach.id: Saya menggunakan zero-row probe dan capacity probe untuk memastikan penyebabnya adalah capacity throttling, sekaligus mengoreksi diagnosis sebelumnya. Pembacaan 83.824 baris saya ganti dengan sekitar 3.000 agregat yang di-stream.

approach.en: I added a private, Entra-protected backend for AI executive briefings. After measuring slow non-streaming responses, I moved chat to a Fabric data agent over the gold tables, published to Microsoft 365 Copilot so planners ask questions where they already work.
approach.id: Saya menambahkan backend privat dengan proteksi Entra untuk executive briefing berbasis AI. Setelah mengukur respons non-streaming yang lambat, saya memindahkan chat ke Fabric data agent yang membaca tabel gold. Agent ini dipublikasikan ke Microsoft 365 Copilot agar tim perencana bisa bertanya dari tempat mereka bekerja.

approach.en: I migrated the client's on-premise database into Fabric with a medallion model, as one fail-fast, stage-resumable pipeline: data contract, bronze ingestion, silver data-quality rules, forecast adapter, gold serving tables and app sync with reconciliation.
approach.id: Saya memigrasikan database on-premise klien ke Fabric dengan model medallion, sebagai satu pipeline yang fail-fast dan bisa dilanjutkan per tahap: data contract, ingestion bronze, aturan data quality silver, forecast adapter, tabel serving gold, serta sinkronisasi aplikasi dengan rekonsiliasi.

tagline.en: The bilingual portfolio site of MII's Microsoft AI practice, in dark and light themes, with a multi-agent RAG assistant that answers with citations and a /dashboard Studio for content and analytics.
tagline.id: Situs portofolio dwibahasa untuk praktik Microsoft AI di MII, dengan tema gelap dan terang, asisten RAG multi-agent yang menjawab dengan sitasi, dan Studio /dashboard untuk konten dan analitik.

problem.en: MII's Microsoft AI practice needed a public portfolio of its non-confidential work. The assistant had to answer only from curated content with citations, resist prompt injection and stay within an enforceable daily budget. The team also needed a studio to publish projects and read analytics without an engineer.
problem.id: Praktik Microsoft AI di MII membutuhkan portofolio publik untuk karya yang tidak rahasia. Asistennya harus menjawab hanya dari konten terkurasi dengan sitasi, tahan terhadap prompt injection, dan mengikuti batas anggaran harian yang dapat ditegakkan. Tim juga membutuhkan studio untuk menerbitkan proyek dan membaca analitik tanpa engineer.

approach.en: I built the bilingual Next.js site and its BFF: a dark and light themed portfolio with a project matcher that ranks published projects for a visitor's business challenge.
approach.id: Saya membangun situs Next.js dwibahasa beserta BFF-nya: portofolio bertema gelap dan terang dengan project matcher yang mengurutkan proyek yang sudah terbit sesuai tantangan bisnis pengunjung.

approach.en: I built the assistant on a FastAPI backend: a deterministic router and three YAML agents using Microsoft Agent Framework, with a guarded fallback tier when a model path fails.
approach.id: Saya membangun asisten di backend FastAPI: router deterministik dan tiga YAML agent menggunakan Microsoft Agent Framework, dengan tier fallback yang tetap mengikuti guardrail saat jalur model gagal.

approach.en: I combined Cosmos DB vector search and Azure AI Search hybrid retrieval with citation gating, Prompt Shields and sentence-level output checks.
approach.id: Saya menggabungkan vector search Cosmos DB dan hybrid retrieval Azure AI Search dengan citation gating, Prompt Shields, serta pemeriksaan output per kalimat.

approach.en: I built the /dashboard Studio behind Microsoft Entra ID: a project catalogue editor, document indexing, consultation reservations, cookieless analytics and reviews of assistant conversations.
approach.id: Saya membangun Studio /dashboard di balik Microsoft Entra ID: editor katalog proyek, pengindeksan dokumen, reservasi konsultasi, analitik tanpa cookie, dan peninjauan percakapan asisten.

approach.en: I fixed production failures that were not being surfaced: broken stream framing, telemetry reporting zero requests and a daily spend cap that undercounted tokens.
approach.id: Saya memperbaiki kegagalan produksi yang tidak terdeteksi: framing stream yang membuat asisten tidak berfungsi, telemetry yang melaporkan nol request, dan spend cap harian yang menghitung token terlalu rendah.

title.en: Clearbox AI Inbox Cleanup for Gmail and Outlook
title.id: Clearbox, Pembersih Inbox AI untuk Gmail dan Outlook

tagline.en: A self-hosted inbox assistant for Gmail and Outlook: Microsoft-Decision-1 pre-sorts every email into trash, archive, keep or unsure with its reasons, and nothing moves until the owner confirms one Clean up.
tagline.id: Asisten inbox self-hosted untuk Gmail dan Outlook: Microsoft-Decision-1 memilah setiap email ke trash, archive, keep, atau unsure beserta alasannya, dan tidak ada email yang dipindahkan sebelum pemiliknya mengonfirmasi satu Clean up.

role.en: Solo builder: product design, implementation, infrastructure and tests (open source, MIT)
role.id: Pembangun tunggal: desain produk, implementasi, infrastruktur, dan pengujian (open source, MIT)

problem.en: Cleaning a busy inbox means reading email by email. Simple filter rules either miss bulk mail or trash something that mattered, and hosted cleanup services need broad access to the mailbox.
problem.id: Membersihkan inbox yang ramai berarti membaca email satu per satu. Aturan filter sederhana sering melewatkan email massal atau justru membuang email penting, sementara layanan pembersih yang di-host pihak lain membutuhkan akses luas ke mailbox.

approach.en: I built a pipeline per email: signals from headers and history, guardrails that cap the allowed action, Microsoft-Decision-1 on Microsoft Foundry for trash, archive, keep and unsure probabilities, per-sender priors, then a deterministic fusion that suggests trash only above a calibrated threshold.
approach.id: Saya membangun pipeline untuk setiap email: sinyal dari header dan riwayat, guardrail yang membatasi aksi yang diizinkan, Microsoft-Decision-1 di Microsoft Foundry untuk probabilitas trash, archive, keep, dan unsure, prior per pengirim, lalu fusion deterministik yang hanya menyarankan trash di atas threshold yang sudah dikalibrasi.

approach.en: Review groups email by sender with a confidence band and up to three reasons from real signals; one Clean up moves only approved mail to Trash or Archive, with Undo for 24 hours and no permanent delete path.
approach.id: Halaman Review mengelompokkan email per pengirim dengan tingkat keyakinan dan hingga tiga alasan dari sinyal nyata; satu Clean up hanya memindahkan email yang disetujui ke Trash atau Archive, dengan Undo selama 24 jam dan tanpa jalur penghapusan permanen.

approach.en: A nightly job tunes the trash threshold to the lowest value that keeps agreement with the owner's trash decisions at or above 98%, so every approval and override teaches it.
approach.id: Job malam hari menyetel threshold trash ke nilai terendah yang menjaga kesesuaian dengan keputusan trash pemilik di 98% atau lebih, sehingga setiap persetujuan dan koreksi menjadi bahan belajar.

approach.en: It runs on Cloudflare Workers and D1 (EU jurisdiction) behind Cloudflare Access, with least-privilege OAuth, AES-256-GCM encrypted tokens, metadata and snippets only, and a Bicep deployment for the model in Sweden Central.
approach.id: Aplikasi ini berjalan di Cloudflare Workers dan D1 (yurisdiksi EU) di balik Cloudflare Access, dengan OAuth least-privilege, token terenkripsi AES-256-GCM, hanya metadata dan cuplikan email, serta deployment Bicep untuk model di Sweden Central.

title.en: Sewise Fashion Labs: Made-to-Measure Sewing Patterns
title.id: Sewise Fashion Labs: Pattern Jahit Made-to-Measure

tagline.en: A 2026 hackathon build that turns a garment sketch and five body measurements into a made-to-measure sewing pattern, the exact fabric to buy for each roll width and a shopping list, plus circular fashion tools for old clothes.
tagline.id: Hasil hackathon 2026 yang mengubah sketsa pakaian dan lima ukuran tubuh menjadi pattern jahit made-to-measure, jumlah kain yang tepat untuk setiap lebar gulungan, dan daftar belanja, ditambah fitur circular fashion untuk pakaian lama.

role.en: Built for a 2026 hackathon (Deep Domain AI direction) and planned for a four-person team; Kurniadi wrote all the code (118 commits, 40 pull requests) with GitHub Copilot and GitHub Spec Kit
role.id: Dibangun untuk hackathon 2026 (arah Deep Domain AI) dan direncanakan untuk tim empat orang; seluruh kodenya ditulis Kurniadi (118 commit, 40 pull request) dengan GitHub Copilot dan GitHub Spec Kit

problem.en: Home sewers, small tailors and fashion students in Indonesia need pattern-making skills to turn a design into a pattern that fits. Fabric is bought from generic charts that ignore the roll width, notions get forgotten, and old clothes are thrown away even when they could be reused.
problem.id: Penjahit rumahan, penjahit kecil, dan mahasiswa mode di Indonesia membutuhkan keahlian pattern making untuk mengubah desain menjadi pattern yang pas. Kain dibeli berdasarkan tabel umum yang mengabaikan lebar gulungan, perlengkapan jahit sering terlupa, dan pakaian lama dibuang padahal masih bisa dipakai ulang.

approach.en: I kept every number that ends up on fabric in deterministic, tested code: a Python drafting engine drafts the bodice, sleeves, peplum and skirt from five measurements, and a fit report checks every pair of seams that are sewn together against its target in millimetres.
approach.id: Saya menjaga setiap angka yang berakhir di kain tetap berada di kode yang deterministik dan teruji: drafting engine Python menyusun bodice, lengan, peplum, dan rok dari lima ukuran, lalu fit report memeriksa setiap pasangan jahitan yang disatukan terhadap targetnya dalam milimeter.

approach.en: A nesting engine lays the pieces out on 110, 115 and 150 cm fabric with grainline rules, falls back to a simpler layout heuristic when the main engine is unavailable, and turns the metres to buy into a shopping list with thread, zipper and needle.
approach.id: Nesting engine menata potongan pada kain selebar 110, 115, dan 150 cm sesuai aturan grainline, beralih ke heuristik tata letak yang lebih sederhana saat engine utama tidak tersedia, lalu mengubah jumlah meter yang harus dibeli menjadi daftar belanja lengkap dengan benang, ritsleting, dan jarum.

approach.en: AI only reads intent and orchestrates: Azure OpenAI reads a sketch into a constrained design spec, and an assistant on Microsoft Agent Framework calls the deterministic services as tools. Without the model, the samples and the manual spec form keep the whole flow working.
approach.id: AI hanya membaca maksud pengguna dan mengorkestrasi: Azure OpenAI membaca sketsa menjadi design spec yang dibatasi, dan asisten di Microsoft Agent Framework memanggil layanan deterministik sebagai tool. Tanpa model, sampel dan formulir spec manual tetap membuat seluruh alur berjalan.

approach.en: I froze the API contracts first (Pydantic models, OpenAPI and generated TypeScript types), then built nine feature specs with GitHub Copilot and GitHub Spec Kit on Cosmos DB, Blob Storage and Azure Container Apps scripts that need only Contributor access.
approach.id: Saya membekukan kontrak API terlebih dahulu (model Pydantic, OpenAPI, dan tipe TypeScript yang di-generate), lalu membangun sembilan feature spec dengan GitHub Copilot dan GitHub Spec Kit di atas Cosmos DB, Blob Storage, dan skrip Azure Container Apps yang hanya membutuhkan akses Contributor.

summary.en: Analyzes sentiment in Indonesian digital wallet app reviews with CNN and LSTM.
summary.id: Menganalisis sentimen dalam ulasan aplikasi dompet digital Indonesia dengan CNN dan LSTM.

publications.abstract: We apply deep learning to sentiment analysis of Indonesian digital wallet reviews. Reviews of four popular Indonesian e-wallet apps were collected from the Google Play Store and grouped into five aspects: accessibility, transactions, accounts, service and performance. A combined CNN and LSTM architecture classifies the sentiment of each review, reaching 87% training accuracy and 83% validation accuracy. Across the four apps, user sentiment leans negative in every aspect category.

publications.venue: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Cybernetics Technology & Applications (ICICyTA)

summary.en: Forecasts COVID-19 case trends to study Indonesia's path to herd immunity.
summary.id: Memprediksi tren kasus COVID-19 untuk mengkaji kemungkinan tercapainya herd immunity di Indonesia.

publications.abstract: Herd immunity decides whether the COVID-19 outbreak is under control, and government policy on social restrictions and vaccination shapes how fast a country reaches it. This study analyzes the dynamics of COVID-19 cases in Indonesia against government policies, from large-scale social restrictions (PSBB) to emergency restrictions (PPKM Darurat), and the vaccination rate, and finds vaccination to be the key factor. Case and vaccination time series are forecast with an N-BEATS model to support the analysis, which estimated that positive cases would decline from October 2021 and that a mask removal policy could follow around February 2022. The study does not model vaccine-resistant variants, which could delay herd immunity.

A fine-tuned IndoBERT model classifies Indonesian posts by sentiment, and a Django dashboard turns the results into trends, filters and exports. The system was built with an iterative incremental method and checked with black box testing and a user acceptance test.
